changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetFieldHash]() RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, CONVERT( varchar(32), SUBSTRING(HASHBYTES('SHA1', STRING_AGG(cast(FieldTypeID as nvarchar) + ':' + Value, char(59))), 3, 32), 2) as FieldHash from Asset A inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = A.AssetTypeID inner join Field F on F.AssetID = A.ID and FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID group by A.AssetTypeID, A.ID )
